info.title: Tassyir Admin API
info.summary: The API installed apps call to read and change a Tassyir business, and the webhooks they receive.
info.description:
Version `2026-10` of the API installed Tassyir apps call. The routes live under `/apps/2026-10/`; the token endpoint and the key documents under `/apps/`. Guides, and a page for every error code: https://developers.tassyir.io.

**Authentication.** `Authorization: Bearer tsy_at_…` from `POST /apps/oauth/token`. An app acts as a team member of the business: it reads and writes only what its granted scopes allow, only in the stores the merchant gave it, under the merchant's plan. An app on Tassyir Hosting holds no token: it calls these routes through `ctx.props.TASSYIR.fetch`, which signs each call as its installation (the same scopes, stores and plan; Idempotency-Key passes through), and a call that cannot be accepted is 401 `HOSTED_CALL_REFUSED`.

**Conventions.** JSON fields are camelCase; ids are strings; times are ISO 8601 UTC; money is a decimal string (`"2500.00"`) with a `currency` field, never a number. A list answers `{ data, nextCursor }`, newest first, keyset-paged: `limit` 1 to 100 (default 50), `cursor` = the previous `nextCursor`. A single resource answers `{ data }`. `fields` trims a resource to the named top-level fields. Fields without `read_customer_contact` (buyer name, phones, address, notes) are omitted, not nulled. Every answer is `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Writes.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make a write safe to retry (24 hours per installation).

**Errors.** `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`, a `fix` sentence, the `docs` page of the code and a `requestId`. Each operation lists every code it can answer; `x-tassyir-errors` lists every code a problem can carry, with its title, statuses and `fix`. HTTP 460 `STORE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN` means a store outside the installation's stores.

**Rate limits.** A leaky bucket per installation, by default 40 requests refilled at 4 a second: every answer carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; a refusal is 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`. All the apps of one business also share a ceiling, by default 20 requests a second: 429 `BUSINESS_RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`. An API process that is already running its maximum of app requests answers 503 `API_BUSY` with `Retry-After`, having done nothing.

**Webhooks.** Signed Standard Webhooks deliveries (`v1a`, Ed25519), one per topic below; verify them with `GET /apps/webhook-keys`.

post.description:
Always a DRAFT, owned by the calling installation: publish it with `POST /offers/{id}/publish`. The body is the dashboard's create body (`kind`, `method`, `title`, `label`, `config`, `combinesWith`, `eligibility`, limits, dates, `targets`, and up to 250 `codes` for a `code` offer) with the store in the body: `config` is the rule exactly as the Offers page stores it, not the shape `GET /offers` answers. IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a write safe to retry: the same key with the same method, path, query and body within 24 hours answers the stored result (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`) without running the write again. Only a successful answer is stored, so a retry after a failure runs. A key reused for a different request is 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; one whose first request still runs is 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE`.

X-Request-Id.description: The request's id, also in an error's `requestId`.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present on the stored answer of a write repeated with the same `Idempotency-Key`: the write did not run again.

API_BUSY.title: API busy
API_BUSY.fix: Nothing was done: wait the number of seconds in Retry-After, then retry with exponential backoff.

APP_DATA_KEY_NOT_DECLARED.title: App data key not declared
APP_DATA_KEY_NOT_DECLARED.fix: Declare the key for this owner under [[data.definitions]] in the app's manifest; it can be written once the merchant accepts that version.

APP_DATA_LIMIT_REACHED.title: App data limit reached
APP_DATA_LIMIT_REACHED.fix: Delete values the app no longer needs with DELETE /data/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{key}, then retry; rewriting a key that exists is never refused.

APP_DATA_VALUE_INVALID.title: App data value invalid
APP_DATA_VALUE_INVALID.fix: Send a value of the declaredType the manifest gives this key, without the part named in reason.

APP_DATA_VALUE_TOO_LARGE.title: App data value too large
APP_DATA_VALUE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Keep each value within limitBytes of compact JSON: split it across several keys, or store a reference instead.

APP_TOKEN_INVALID.title: Access token invalid
APP_TOKEN_INVALID.fix: Get a new access token from POST /apps/oauth/token, then retry the request.

APP_TOKEN_REQUIRED.title: Access token required
APP_TOKEN_REQUIRED.fix: Send the access token in the Authorization header as Bearer tsy_at_….

BAD_REQUEST.title: Bad request
BAD_REQUEST.fix: Correct the request as the detail says, then retry.
BAD_REQUEST.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 400 that carries no more specific code.

BRAND_NOT_FOUND.title: Bad request
BRAND_NOT_FOUND.fix: Send the id of a brand of the product's store, or null for none; the ids in brandIds are not.

BULK_EXPORTS_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: Service unavailable
BULK_EXPORTS_NOT_CONFIGURED.fix: Page through the list route instead, or retry later.

BULK_EXPORT_IN_PROGRESS.title: Conflict
BULK_EXPORT_IN_PROGRESS.fix: Wait for the export named in bulkExportId to finish (the bulk/finished webhook, or GET /bulk/exports/{id}), then ask again.

BULK_EXPORT_RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
BULK_EXPORT_RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After; keep a finished export and read it again instead of exporting the same list twice.

BUSINESS_RATE_LIMITED.title: Business's rate limit exceeded
BUSINESS_RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After, then retry; every app of this business shares this budget, so spread requests over time.

CANCEL_NOTE_REQUIRED.title: Bad request
CANCEL_NOTE_REQUIRED.fix: Send a note with this cancel reason: the merchant set it to require one.

CANCEL_REASON_INVALID.title: Bad request
CANCEL_REASON_INVALID.fix: Read GET /cancel-reasons again and send the id of one of its reasons, or no reason.

COLLECTION_CONDITIONAL_LIMIT.title: Conflict
COLLECTION_CONDITIONAL_LIMIT.fix: Make this collection without conditions, or remove the conditions of another first: the store has its maximum of collections with conditions (limit).

COLLECTION_DEPTH_LIMIT.title: Conflict
COLLECTION_DEPTH_LIMIT.fix: Choose a parent higher in the tree: collections nest at most limit levels deep, with their subcollections.

COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND.title: Bad request
COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND.fix: Name only collections of the product's store that still exist; the ids in categoryIds are not.

COLLECTION_PARENT_CYCLE.title: Conflict
COLLECTION_PARENT_CYCLE.fix: Choose a parent that is neither this collection nor one of its own subcollections.

COLLECTION_PARENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
COLLECTION_PARENT_NOT_FOUND.fix: Send as parentId a collection of the same store that still exists, or null for a top-level collection.

COLLECTION_PRODUCT_WRONG_STORE.title: Bad request
COLLECTION_PRODUCT_WRONG_STORE.fix: Add only products of the collection's store; the ids in productIds are not.

COLLECTION_RULE_INVALID.title: Bad request
COLLECTION_RULE_INVALID.fix: Correct the condition at index as reason says; a brand or tag it names must be the store's own.

CONFLICT.title: Conflict
CONFLICT.fix: Read the resource again and act on its current state; do not retry the same request unchanged.
CONFLICT.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 409 that carries no more specific code.

DELIVERY_SPEED_UNAVAILABLE.title: Bad request
DELIVERY_SPEED_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Use the standard speed: economy is not priced for this commune and delivery method.

DELIVERY_SPEED_UNSUPPORTED.title: Bad request
DELIVERY_SPEED_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Use the standard speed: the order's carrier has no economy service.

DEV_STORE_ORDER_LIMIT_REACHED.title: Too many requests
DEV_STORE_ORDER_LIMIT_REACHED.fix: Wait the number of seconds in retryAfterSeconds (until the next day in Algiers): a dev store takes at most limit new orders a day.

FORBIDDEN.title: Forbidden
FORBIDDEN.fix: Do not retry the same request: the detail says what this installation may not do.
FORBIDDEN.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 403 that carries no more specific code.

HOSTED_CALL_REFUSED.title: Hosted call refused
HOSTED_CALL_REFUSED.fix: Call the Admin API through ctx.props.TASSYIR.fetch from the request that received it; if the installation is still active, retry after a short wait.

HTML_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Markup not allowed
HTML_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Send plain formatted HTML (paragraphs, headings, lists, links, Tassyir CDN images) without the parts listed in problems.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.title: Invalid Idempotency-Key
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.fix: Send 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, for example a UUID.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE.title: Idempotency-Key in use
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE.fix: Wait for the first request with this Idempotency-Key to finish, then retry.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.title: Idempotency-Key reused
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.fix: Use a new Idempotency-Key for a different request; reuse a key only to retry the identical request.

IDEMPOTENCY_UNAVAILABLE.title: Idempotency store unavailable
IDEMPOTENCY_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key in a few seconds.

IMAGE_FETCH_FAILED.title: Image could not be downloaded
IMAGE_FETCH_FAILED.fix: Check that the address opens the image from the public internet over https with a valid certificate; retry later if the server was down.

IMAGE_QUOTA_REACHED.title: Image upload quota reached
IMAGE_QUOTA_REACHED.fix: Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After, then upload the rest more slowly.

IMAGE_TOO_LARGE.title: Image too large
IMAGE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Send a smaller image: at most 10 MB, 12,000 pixels on a side and 100 megapixels.

IMAGE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Not a supported image
IMAGE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Send a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image; convert an SVG or any other format to one of these first.

IMAGE_URL_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Image address not allowed
IMAGE_URL_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Send the https address (port 443, no user or password) of the image on a public web server, by its host name.

INSUFFICIENT_AT_LOCATION.title: Conflict
INSUFFICIENT_AT_LOCATION.fix: Read the level again and remove at most what it holds: stock never goes below zero.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Internal error
INTERNAL_ERROR.fix: Retry with exponential backoff; if it keeps failing, report the requestId to Tassyir.
INTERNAL_ERROR.fallback: A 5xx failure with a status other than 503, when it carries no more specific code.

INVALID_CURSOR.title: Invalid cursor
INVALID_CURSOR.fix: Pass the nextCursor of the previous page unchanged with the same filters, or start again without a cursor.

INVALID_FIELDS.title: Unknown fields
INVALID_FIELDS.fix: Name only fields listed in allowedFields, separated by commas.

LOCATION_NOT_FOUND.title: Bad request
LOCATION_NOT_FOUND.fix: Name an active location of this business, or leave locationId out to use the default location.

MEDIA_URL_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Image address not allowed
MEDIA_URL_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Upload the image with POST /images and use the URL it answers (https://cdn.tassyir.io/…), or keep one this resource already shows; do not link images hosted elsewhere.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Method not allowed
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Call the operation with the method its reference names.
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 405 that carries no more specific code.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the path and the id; a resource outside this installation's stores reads as not found.
NOT_FOUND.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 404 that carries no more specific code.

OFFER_ARCHIVED.title: Conflict
OFFER_ARCHIVED.fix: Create a new offer: an archived one is history and cannot be changed.

OFFER_CODE_INVALID.title: Bad request
OFFER_CODE_INVALID.fix: Send a code of 3 to 30 characters: letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

OFFER_CODE_NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
OFFER_CODE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Name a code of this offer (GET /offers/{id}/codes).

OFFER_CODE_TAKEN.title: Conflict
OFFER_CODE_TAKEN.fix: Choose another code: codes are unique across the whole business, disabled ones included.

OFFER_ENDED.title: Conflict
OFFER_ENDED.fix: Move endsAt to a later date with PATCH /offers/{id}: an ended offer is not resumed.

OFFER_GONE.title: Conflict
OFFER_GONE.fix: Send the order again: the offer behind the code was deleted, and the retry will list the code in rejectedCodes and create the order without it.

OFFER_INVALID.title: Bad request
OFFER_INVALID.fix: Correct the fields listed in errors (each has a field and a code), then send the request again.

OFFER_KIND_IMMUTABLE.title: Bad request
OFFER_KIND_IMMUTABLE.fix: Leave kind and method as the offer has them: create a new offer to change either.

OFFER_KIND_NOT_AVAILABLE.title: Bad request
OFFER_KIND_NOT_AVAILABLE.fix: Create an offer of a kind the dashboard offers today; the other kinds in the model open later.

OFFER_LIMIT_REACHED.title: Conflict
OFFER_LIMIT_REACHED.fix: Send the order again: the code (or offer) has no uses left, and the retry will list the code in rejectedCodes as code_used_up and create the order without it.

OFFER_NOT_CODE_METHOD.title: Conflict
OFFER_NOT_CODE_METHOD.fix: Only an offer created with method "code" has codes; create a code offer to use them.

OFFER_NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
OFFER_NOT_FOUND.fix: The offer was deleted between the check and the change; read the list again.

OFFER_NOT_OWNED.title: Offer not owned by this app
OFFER_NOT_OWNED.fix: Create your own offer with POST /offers and change that one; the merchant edits their own offers in the dashboard.

OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED.title: Conflict
OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED.fix: Publish the draft with POST /offers/{id}/publish first.

OFFER_STORE_NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
OFFER_STORE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Send the id of a store of this business that the installation may access (GET /stores).

OFFER_TARGET_NOT_FOUND.title: Bad request
OFFER_TARGET_NOT_FOUND.fix: Target only products, variants and collections of this business that still exist; the ids in the offer's targets are not.

OFFER_TARGET_OUTSIDE_STORE.title: Bad request
OFFER_TARGET_OUTSIDE_STORE.fix: Target only products, variants and collections of the offer's store.

OFFER_VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Conflict
OFFER_VERSION_CONFLICT.fix: Read the offer again (currentVersion is its version now) and send expectedVersion with the change, or leave expectedVersion out.

ORDER_DUPLICATE.title: Duplicate order
ORDER_DUPLICATE.fix: Do not retry: the buyer already has this order, which the merchant handles.

ORDER_LIMIT_REACHED.title: Order waiting for the plan allowance
ORDER_LIMIT_REACHED.fix: Retry after the merchant upgrades or the plan's next order cycle starts.

ORDER_NOT_EDITABLE.title: Order no longer editable
ORDER_NOT_EDITABLE.fix: Leave this order as it is: once with a carrier it changes only through the delivery.

ORDER_PRICING_LOCKED.title: Bad request
ORDER_PRICING_LOCKED.fix: Leave the wilaya, commune and delivery as they are: the order is with a carrier, delivered or returned, so its price no longer changes.

ORDER_STATUS_CONFLICT.title: Status change not allowed
ORDER_STATUS_CONFLICT.fix: Read the order again and act on its current status; do not retry the same move.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.title: Payload too large
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.fix: Send a smaller body: split the write into several requests.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 413 that carries no more specific code.

PLAN_FEATURE_REQUIRED.title: Not included in the merchant's plan
PLAN_FEATURE_REQUIRED.fix: The merchant's plan does not include this feature; it works once the merchant upgrades.

PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED.title: Merchant's plan limit reached
PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED.fix: The merchant's plan limit is reached; it works once the merchant upgrades or frees capacity.

PRODUCT_DEFAULT_VARIANT.title: Default variant follows its product
PRODUCT_DEFAULT_VARIANT.fix: Change the product's own fields with PATCH /products/{id}; its default variant follows them.

PRODUCT_OPTIONS_REQUIRE_VARIANTS.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_OPTIONS_REQUIRE_VARIANTS.fix: Send variants with the options: one for each combination of their values.

PRODUCT_OPTION_DUPLICATE_NAME.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_OPTION_DUPLICATE_NAME.fix: Give each option a different name (case and surrounding spaces are ignored when comparing).

PRODUCT_OPTION_DUPLICATE_VALUE.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_OPTION_DUPLICATE_VALUE.fix: List each value of an option once (case and surrounding spaces are ignored when comparing).

PRODUCT_OPTION_NOT_FOUND.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_OPTION_NOT_FOUND.fix: Name in a variant's options only options the product has, spelled as in options.

PRODUCT_OPTION_NO_VALUES.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_OPTION_NO_VALUES.fix: Give every option at least one value that is not empty.

PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE_EMPTY.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE_EMPTY.fix: Remove the empty value: every option value needs at least one visible character.

PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE_NOT_FOUND.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Select in each variant only values its option lists in options.

PRODUCT_SLUG_INVALID.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_SLUG_INVALID.fix: Send a slug with at least one letter that is not a reserved word, or leave it out to derive it from the name.

PRODUCT_SLUG_TAKEN.title: Conflict
PRODUCT_SLUG_TAKEN.fix: Send another slug, or leave it out: another product of this store already uses this one.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_COMBINATION_MISMATCH.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_COMBINATION_MISMATCH.fix: Send exactly one variant for each combination of option values, none twice.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_COUNT_MISMATCH.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_COUNT_MISMATCH.fix: Send one variant per combination of option values: as many variants as the product of the options' value counts.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_DUPLICATE_COMBINATION.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_DUPLICATE_COMBINATION.fix: Give each variant a different combination of option values.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_DUPLICATE_OPTION.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_DUPLICATE_OPTION.fix: Name each option once in a variant's options.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_INVALID_VALUE.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_INVALID_VALUE.fix: Select for each option one of the values it lists in options.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_MISSING_COMBINATIONS.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_MISSING_COMBINATIONS.fix: Add a variant for every combination of option values that has none.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_MISSING_OPTION.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_MISSING_OPTION.fix: Select a value of every option in each variant, none left out.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_SELECTED_COUNT.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_SELECTED_COUNT.fix: Select exactly one value of every option in each variant.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_UNKNOWN_OPTION.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_VARIANT_UNKNOWN_OPTION.fix: Name in a variant's options only options the product has.

PRODUCT_WRITE_TIMEOUT.title: Bad request
PRODUCT_WRITE_TIMEOUT.fix: Nothing was saved: retry the same request, and if it times out again, save fewer options or values at once.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Rate limit exceeded
RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After, then retry; keep an eye on RateLimit-Remaining to spread requests.
RATE_LIMITED.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 429 that carries no more specific code.

REQUEST_FAILED.title: Request failed
REQUEST_FAILED.fix: Act on the status and the detail; if they do not say enough, report the requestId to Tassyir.
REQUEST_FAILED.fallback: A 4xx refusal with a status other than 400, 401, 403, 404, 405, 409, 413, 415, 422, 429 or 460, when it carries no more specific code.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Service unavailable
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 503 that carries no more specific code.

STORE_REQUIRED.title: Bad request
STORE_REQUIRED.fix: Name the store with storeId: this installation acts in several stores.

STORE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN.title: Store not accessible
STORE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN.fix: Only name stores this installation may access; the merchant chooses them when installing the app.
STORE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 460 that carries no more specific code.

SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED.title: Unprocessable request
SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED.fix: Do not retry until the merchant subscribes again: this needs a subscription the business does not have.

UNAUTHORIZED.title: Unauthorized
UNAUTHORIZED.fix: Send a valid access token as Authorization: Bearer tsy_at_…; get a new one from POST /apps/oauth/token.
UNAUTHORIZED.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 401 that carries no more specific code.

UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY.title: Unprocessable request
UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY.fix: Correct the request as the detail says; the same request fails the same way.
UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 422 that carries no more specific code.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.title: Unsupported media type
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.fix: Send the body as JSON, with Content-Type: application/json in UTF-8.
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.fallback: A refusal with HTTP 415 that carries no more specific code.

VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Invalid request
VALIDATION_FAILED.fix: Correct the parameters listed in errors, then retry.
VALIDATION_FAILED.fallback: A 400 refusal that lists its invalid parameters, when it carries no more specific code.
